name: feedbax-feedback
title: Feedbax Feedback
description: A roomy feedback dialog with one-click screenshot capture, an annotation editor (pen, arrow, rectangle, highlight, redact) and single sign-on to your Feedbax portal.
docs: 1) Server: set FEEDBAX_HOST_SECRET (from the portal's .dev.vars) in your server env and add an authenticated POST /api/feedbax-token route that returns { token: await mintFeedbaxToken({ secret, user: { id, name } }) } with Cache-Control: no-store. Take the user from your own session, never from the request body, and import lib/feedbax/token.server.ts from server code only. 2) Render <FeedbaxDialog portalUrl="https://your-portal" /> (and optionally <FeedbaxLink portalUrl="https://your-portal">Go to feedback</FeedbaxLink>). 3) Set appUrl in the portal's feedbax.config.ts to your app's URL and redeploy the portal. Mark anything that must not appear in screenshots with data-feedbax-ignore.
